title: Reads
body: Live balances, open items, org structure, ticket history. Anvil answers from the record in your system, not from a warehouse copy that was correct last night.

title: Decides
body: Your close checklist, your approval matrix, your materiality thresholds. Anything outside them becomes an exception with the reasoning attached, not a guess.

title: Executes
body: Posts the entry, matches the invoice, grants the access, files the case. Every write is reversible, attributable and waiting on a named approver.
